verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AI-powered categorization of card transactions at time of spend and automatic sync to accounting systems, which reduces month-end reconciliation work — supporting the 'coded as it happens' close story. However, explicit evidence for memo entry, receipt capture/attachment workflows, and independent (non-vendor) validation of accuracy is absent. Missing for 10: explicit receipt capture/memo fields evidence, independent corroboration of coding accuracy, and detail on how coded data feeds the close review process.
